title: Signed total map with tensor-row normalization
statement: Let X,U,F,G,D be as in [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data], and let A,B,C be the totals of the Cech double complexes of the three resolutions [def-sc-cech-cup-resolution-comparison-data]. There exists a cochain morphism Tot(A tensor B) → C whose value on every pure tensor of the inclusions of row cochains a in C^i(U,D.left.K^r) and b in C^j(U,D.right.K^s) is (-1)^(i*s) times the inclusion of cupCechPairCochain U D r s i j a b [new-cup-cech-pair-cochain] in target bidegree (r+s,i+j). The input total degrees m,n may be any naturals satisfying r+i=m and s+j=n. No alpha or beta identity is assumed in this statement.

source.place: Remark 20.25.3, signed total tensor map of equation 07MB

proof.text: Extend the explicit signed row-pairing formula over pure tensors and finite diagonal coproducts to total-degree components; local O-linearity and restriction of scalars give global-ring bilinearity.

Use D.leibniz for the resolution differential and alternating front/back omitted-face cancellation for the Cech differential. D.restriction identifies composites. The factor (-1)^(i*s) matches the resolution-first total convention. These identities verify the cochain law on generators, giving the asserted morphism and its defining tensor-row formula.

theorem exists_cupCech_total_cochain_map {X : Scheme.{u}} {ι : Type u}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) {F G : X.Modules} (D : CupResolutionPairing F G) :
    let A := (cupCechDouble U D.left.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let B := (cupCechDouble U D.right.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    let C := (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
    ∃ h : HomologicalComplex.mapBifunctor A B (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤)))
        (ComplexShape.up ℕ) ⟶ C,
      ∀ (r s i j m n : ℕ) (hm : r + i = m) (hn : s + j = n)
        (a : ((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).X r).X i)
        (b : ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).X s).X j),
        h.f (m + n)
          (HomologicalComplex.ιMapBifunctor A B
            (curriedTensor (ModuleCat.{u} Γ(X, ⊤))) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
            m n (m + n) rfl
            (((cupCechDouble U D.left.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
                r i m (by simpa using hm) a) ⊗ₜ[Γ(X, ⊤)]
              ((cupCechDouble U D.right.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
                s j n (by simpa using hn) b))) =
          (-1 : ℤ) ^ (i * s) •
            (cupCechDouble U D.target.K).ιTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)
              (r + s) (i + j) (m + n) (by dsimp; omega)
              (cupCechPairCochain U D r s i j a b)
